about: Hand-maintained input of scripts/gen_model_catalog.py, which writes agent_core/core/models/model_catalog.json. Everything here changes when providers change, so it is data: edit it and rerun the generator. sources: where each model's limits come from. surfaces: facts about a surface (a CraftBot provider key, or its subscription surface). Its cache_lifetime applies to every model of it that the source prices cache reads for; reports_cached_tokens says whether its responses report cached input (default true). models: facts per model, merged over what the sources give; same_as first copies another model's row.

sources.note: CraftBot provider key -> models.dev provider id; both must serve the same model ids at the same endpoint. Not mapped: byteplus (models.dev lists only the China Volcengine naming) and local servers (they run whatever window the user loaded).
The ChatGPT-subscription backend's model catalogue: the window Codex runs each model at.

openai.note: Before GPT-5.6 a cached prefix typically lasts 5 to 10 minutes idle (in_memory) or about 30 minutes (24h retention), depending on the organization: the shorter figure. From GPT-5.6 on it lasts at least 30 minutes after its last write or reuse; those models are listed under models.

anthropic.note: CraftBot asks for ttl=1h on session calls (transports/anthropic_messages.py); every hit or write restarts it, counted from the request's start.

bedrock.note: cachePoint is sent without a ttl: five minutes, restarted by every cache hit.

fireworks.note: Reports cached input in a response header only.

remote.note: Ollama's API reports no cached count.

vllm.note: Only with --enable-prompt-tokens-details, which is off by default.
